app_fee.value: A $75 non-refundable application fee applies to the graduate application.

fee_waiver.value: Automatic waivers are only for McNair Scholars, Fulbright students, U.S. veterans and SU students and alumni. The chemistry page says no application fees will be waived for its 2026 cycle.
fee_waiver.quote: The Graduate School automatically waives application fees for: McNair Scholars, Fulbright students, U.S. veterans/active-duty U.S. military personnel, and SU students and alumni

also.quote: no application fees or English language proficiency exam requirements will be waived

gre_general.value: No Graduate School policy was reachable. The engineering school calls the GRE optional, physics does not consider it and math does not consider the general test; see each program.

toefl_min.value: No Syracuse-wide TOEFL minimum appears on the fetched pages; the engineering and physics pages give none.

ielts_min.value: No Syracuse-wide IELTS minimum appears on the fetched pages.

english_waiver.value: Applicants from countries not on the exempt list must submit a test, but India is not named on the quoted text.

also.quote: Countries That Do Not Require English Language Proficiency Scores

notes: The Graduate School site (gradschool.syracuse.edu) returned a proxy tunnel error and the graduate course catalog returned 502, so this record uses the engineering school's requirements page (same $75 fee and English list as the Arts & Sciences pages). The VPA international page (TOEFL 90, IELTS 6.5) is for the College of Visual and Performing Arts only and is not used here.
